findings.title: Pod resolves names with the node's DNS
findings.cause: container client exits because api.kd-dnspolicy-default.svc.cluster.local does not resolve: the pod sets dnsPolicy Default, which means the node's resolver, and that resolver knows no Services; its log says: "wget: bad address 'api.kd-dnspolicy-default.svc.cluster.local'"; Deployment client has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container client exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container client's log (current run)

evidence.command: kubectl get pod client-554dbd98f8-w74pd -n kd-dnspolicy-default -o jsonpath='{.spec.hostNetwork}{" "}{.spec.dnsPolicy}'

findings.fix: Set dnsPolicy: ClusterFirst (or remove dnsPolicy), so the pod uses cluster DNS and falls back to the node's resolver for outside names.
